thread:
incident-bot: PAGER — High GPU provisioning failures observed in us-west1 (production). Autoscaler node creations failing with quota errors; model-serving queue growing and elevated 5xx. Pager routed to @oncall-jordan +2. Incident INC-6123456.

oncall-jordan: ack, I'm on it. Pulling autoscaler/controller logs and recent create-node events.

alice: seeing repeated Compute API errors in the controller: 'RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: quotaExceeded for accelerators' when creating gpu-enabled instance.

brian: confirmed from infra logs — all new node requests return 403/QUOTA_EXCEEDED for GPUs in us-west1. Looks like per-project GPU quota reached.

carmen: user-facing impact: queue length for text-generation up ~15x; p50 stable but p99 latency jumped to ~12s; error rate increased to ~4% for some partners. Tracking affected customers on the incident doc.

sasha: can we failover traffic to us-central1 as a safety valve? Do we have capacity/region-policy to burst there?

oncall-jordan: yes, starting a limited region reroute for high-priority routes. Applying route_override -> region=us-central1 for premium routes, will monitor.

ops-runbook: runbook step: 1) attempt emergency quota bump with cloud provider; 2) temporarily route critical traffic to alternate region; 3) reduce batch sizes and pause low-priority long-running jobs.

alice: quick check output from gcloud (excerpt):
```
$ gcloud compute project-info describe --project=redwood-prod
quotas:
- metric: "NVIDIA_TESLA_V100"
  limit: 8.0
  usage: 8.0
  region: us-west1
```
This matches the quota exhausted symptom.

brian: opened a high-priority support case with GCP: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/000123456 — requested emergency quota increase and explained customer impact. Also pinged TAM.

carmen: applying mitigation now: 1) route ~60% of burst load to us-central1, 2) pause non-critical rerank and batch eval jobs, 3) reduce max_batch_size from 64 to 16 for remaining workers to reduce token pressure. Changes deployed.

sasha: metric update: seen immediate drop in queue growth on us-west1; overall error rate down to ~1.2% after reroute. Some customers still hitting higher tail latencies while warmup completes.

oncall-jordan: handing off to day ops @alice at 07:30 UTC. If quota not increased in 30m we will enact full diversion policy and spin up preemptible GPU pools in us-central1 as backup.

alice: ack. I've escalated the GCP ticket and messaged the TAM. Continuing to monitor autoscaler retries and node create errors. Will post any provider ETA here.

incident-bot: UPDATE — mitigations applied, customer impact reduced. Keep notifications in this thread for follow-up and RCA. Close incident after quota resolution and verification of rollbacks.

alice: follow-up note: created internal postmortem stub and added mitigation timeline; will update when GCP confirms quota change or we finish regional drain/rollback.

brian: if anyone needs to replay the autoscaler errors: logs are in stack bucket: gs://redwood-ops/autoscaler/6123456789/errors.log

oncall-jordan: thanks team. Leaving the channel for now — ping me if GCP responds or if rollback begins.
